description: Image Description: The image shows a creatively decorated cake designed to resemble a whimsical farm scene. The cake is multi-tiered, with the bottom tier painted in light blue, possibly representing water or sky, and adorned with white cloud-like patterns. The middle tier is green, resembling grass, and features a red barn door with a white "X" pattern on it, along with small purple flowers scattered around the base. A purple cloth drapes over the top of this tier, creating a tablecloth
